name: Prismander
voice: gentle, worried about you, a little formal
desc: An axolotl whose frills grew into living crystal. It bends light into shields and dazzling beams.

egg.name: Prism Egg
egg.desc: Pink and glassy. It throws little rainbows when it rocks. Something gentle is in here.
egg.play: Shields you and dazzles foes with bent light. Loyal, a bit of a worrier.
